topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and objectives for the lecture on inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue injury through molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory leukocyte recruitment and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sentinel cell activation drives leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic communication, and potential systemic inflammatory complications.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and managing persistent inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing remarks and previews the subject of the subsequent lecture.
